component.name: SAS HBA Storage Console
SAS HBA 存储控制台
component.summary: Inspect SAS, SCSI and RAID controllers and drive SMART data
查看 SAS/SCSI/RAID 控制器与硬盘 SMART，控制单盘启停与安全热拔出

description.p: A graphical console for SAS, SCSI and RAID host bus adapters on Debian and Ubuntu based systems.

ul.li: Discovers every storage controller exposed through sysfs
Resolves the controller model from the board name and the system pci.ids database
Lists attached SAS/SATA drives and reads S.M.A.R.T. health, temperature and attributes
Spins a single idle drive down or up, or safely hot-removes it with a SCSI delete
Manual and automatic refresh, plus SCSI bus rescan for hot-plugged drives
Dark theme by default, requests root through polkit/pkexec on startup
